title: Q-10: Claims feed on the product's own host
body:

Migrated from GitHub issue 10 (Issues are off on the code repository; this file is the record).

ultrastable.io/proof reads qnfo.org/api/platform-claims, which also exposes a repo_url pointing at the public QNFO repository. Serve a product-side feed instead.

size: S

**Closing probe:** GET ultrastable.io/proof feed URL returns 200 with no qnfo.org/api/platform-claims dependency and no repo_url to the QNFO repo.

**Evidence:** closed by the pull request that carries this change
